:::{#exr-matvec-columns-practice}
#### Computing a matrix-vector product as a combination of columns

A linear model's predictions for every observation at once
are a [matrix-vector product](linear-algebra-matrices.qmd#def-matvec-mult) $\matr{A}\vecf{x}$,
and @thm-matvec-columns writes it as a combination of the [columns of $\matr{A}$](linear-algebra-matrices.qmd#def-matrix-column).
Let

$$
\matr{A} = \sbmat{2 & 1 \\ 0 & 3 \\ 1 & -1},
\qquad
\vecf{x} = \sbmat{3 \\ 2}.
$$

Find $\matr{A}\vecf{x}$ with @thm-matvec-columns.

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Hint

Use @thm-matvec-columns with $x_1 = 3$ and $x_2 = 2$.

:::

:::
